app.name: TNViewer
placeholder.title: Not built yet
placeholder.body: This area will be built in a later stage.
map.noBackground: No map background source set up. You only see the Trafficnetwork data.
map.empty: There are no reports in this area.
map.filter.title: Report types
map.filter.none: No report types in this area yet.
status.noCredentials: No access set up. Enter access data under Settings → Connect to server.
emergency.title: Emergency mode
emergency.noServer: No server is reachable yet. The map and the warnings need data from a server. Until then you can queue reports; they are sent as soon as a server is reachable.
emergency.noAccess: No access has been set up yet, so the app loads no data. You can still queue reports; they are sent once an access and a server are there.
emergency.auto: The app keeps trying on its own. The emergency mode ends as soon as data was loaded for the first time.
emergency.driveCalm: No warning data, only your speed
emergency.driveHint: In the emergency mode the drive mode shows only your speed. The speed limit and warnings arrive once data has been loaded. Reports are queued.
status.needsLocation: Without a location the app does not know which data to load. Allow location or choose a region.
web.install.title: Install as an app
web.install.ios: Tap "Share" in the browser, then "Add to Home Screen". Only then does TNViewer run full screen without the browser bar.
web.install.android: Open the browser menu and choose "Install app" or "Add to Home screen". Then TNViewer runs full screen.
web.lock.title: Already open
web.lock.body: TNViewer is already running in another tab or window of this browser. Two tabs would overwrite the stored data of the other. Close the other tab and reload this one.
status.waitingForWifi: Map data is waiting for Wi-Fi (setting "Load on Wi-Fi only").
status.offline: Offline: showing the data loaded last.
camera.question: Is this device still there?
camera.goneThanks: Thanks, your report is being sent.
detail.pending: Not sent yet — will be transmitted at the next sync.
report.title: What do you want to report?
report.hint: Tap the map to choose a different spot.
report.noLocation: No location available. Tap the map to choose a spot.
report.savedDefaultDuration: Saved. The server did not take the requested duration; its default applies.
report.error.ttlUnsupported: The duration can only be chosen after the app has fetched data from the server once. Pick "Default" or try again later.
report.error.ttlRange: This duration is not allowed. For this type {min} to {max} are possible.
report.duration: How long should the report stay?
report.duration.hint: What the server allows for this type; anything else is refused by the app.
limit.title: Speed limit
limit.tapRoad: Tap a road to see its speed limit. If it is missing or wrong you can submit it. If the road is outside the offline area, its exact coordinate is sent to the server for the lookup.
limit.error: The lookup is not possible right now. Check the connection and tap the road again.
limit.origin.locallyProposed: Proposed by you, not confirmed yet
limit.outside: Speed limit not available here: outside the offline area only online.
limit.locked: Submitting is locked while you drive. Stop, then tap the road again.
limit.safety: Only enter what the signs on site show.
limit.privacy: What is sent: the value and the place of the road (exact coordinate), nothing else.
limit.saved: Saved. The proposal is sent as soon as possible.
limit.error.roadAlreadyHasLimit: This road has a speed limit on record by now. It is shown above.
limit.error.storageFull: Device storage is full. Free some space and try again.
limit.error.network: No connection right now. Try again later.
limit.error.failed: The proposal could not be saved.
report.saved: Saved. The report is sent as soon as possible.
report.error.invalidPosition: That spot is not valid. Please choose another.
report.error.invalidType: This report type is not supported.
report.error.storageFull: Device storage is full. Please free some space and try again.
report.error.failed: The report could not be saved.
vote.question: Is the report still current?
vote.thanks: Thanks, your answer is being sent.
vote.error: The answer could not be saved.
pending.wifi: Waiting reports: {count}. They are sent together with the map data when Wi-Fi is available.
pending.offline: Waiting reports: {count}. They are sent when you are online.
pending.sending: Waiting reports: {count}. They are being sent.
rejected.notice: The server did not accept {count} report(s), for example because of a limit or because a similar one already exists. This is not an error.
drive.notification.title: TNViewer drive mode
drive.notification.body: Your location is used for warnings while the drive mode is running.
lock.title: Locked while driving
lock.body: Settings, server pages and text input are locked while you are driving. Stop, or end the drive mode.
lockSwitch.label: Driving lock
lockSwitch.hint: Locks settings, text input and server pages from about 10 km/h while the drive mode is running.
cameras.label: Show and report speed cameras
cameras.hint: Off by default. Which information appears is decided by the country rule of the server.
cameras.policyOff: Speed-camera information is currently not released in your network.
cameras.policyZones: Only danger areas (zones) are shown, no individual spots.
driveNotice.title: Before you start
drive.startHint: Shows speed and speed limit and warns about reports ahead. Your location is used only while the drive mode is running.
drive.simulateHint: Plays an invented demo route, without real movement and without your location.
drive.screenMayDim: The screen does not stay on by itself
drive.heading: Heading {point}
drive.lockOffHint: Tap to switch the driving lock on again
drive.zoneHint: An area, not an exact spot
drive.noPermission: The drive mode cannot run without location access. You can allow it in the system settings.
settings.deleteLocalHint: Deletes the loaded map and report data and resets the settings. It is loaded again afterwards.
settings.resetIdentityHint: Deletes the device key and the device's access to the server network. The device registers anew afterwards; earlier reports are then no longer attributed to it. The driving lock is on again afterwards.
lockSwitch.always: In this version the driving lock is always on: settings, text input and server pages are locked from about 10 km/h while the drive mode is running.
settings.failed: That did not work. Please try again.
server.title: Connect to server
server.addressHint: e.g. node.example.org — leave empty to find servers automatically
server.errorInvalid: That is not a valid server address.
server.errorInsecure: Unencrypted connections (http) are not allowed in this version. Please use https.
server.errorCredentials: Access data does not belong in the address.
server.accessHint: The server has to issue an access so this device may load data. It is kept in the device key store.
join.title: Connect with a code
join.hint: A connection code sets up the server and access for this app. You get it from your server's web page (QR code or text).
join.pasteEmpty: There is no text on the clipboard.
join.confirm.title: Connect to this server?
join.confirm.fingerprintHint: Compare it with the value on your server's web page. If it does not match, cancel.
join.confirm.noRoot: The code carries no network key.
join.confirm.otherNetwork: Warning: this code belongs to a different network than the one built in.
join.confirm.limits: The code only lets this app sign in at this server as an app. It is not a user account. Whoever knows it can do the same; a code shown on a web page is practically public. A foreign code leads into a foreign network: connect only to servers you trust.
join.confirm.replace: You are already connected to {address}. Connecting replaces that setting.
join.done: Connected to {address}. The app is signing in now.
join.disconnectHint: Deletes the server address, access and network key on this device. The app then runs in emergency mode until you enter a new code.
join.error.notAJoinCode: That is not a connection code.
join.error.tooLong: The code is too long and therefore invalid.
join.error.damaged: The code is damaged or incomplete.
join.error.newerVersion: This code is from a newer version. Please update the app.
join.error.badNode: The server address in the code is not valid.
join.error.revoked: The code has been revoked. Get a new one from the server's operator.
join.error.expired: The code has expired. Get a new one from the server's operator.
join.error.exhausted: The code has been used too often.
join.error.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please try again later.
join.locked: Connecting a server is only possible when stationary.
join.scan.title: Scan QR code
join.scan.hint: Point the camera at the QR code on your server's web page.
join.scan.denied: No access to the camera. You can allow it in the iPhone settings or paste the code.
join.scan.failed: The camera could not be started. You can paste the code.
display.title: Display
display.status.incompatible: {name} is connected but is not being fed.
display.unsupported: Bluetooth is not available on this device.
display.problem.off: Bluetooth is off or not allowed. Switch it on or allow it in the phone's settings.
display.useHint: The drive mode sends the speed limit, warnings and prompts to the display.
display.noneFound: No display found. Is it switched on and nearby?
display.forgetHint: The phone keeps any Bluetooth pairing. Remove it in the phone's Bluetooth settings ("Forget this device"), also after a reset on the display.
display.compat.appTooOld: The display speaks a newer protocol version. Update the app.
display.compat.displayTooOld: The display is too old for this app. Update the display.
display.sound.hint: Automatic: on the display while it is connected, otherwise on the phone.
display.voiceHint: Needs a memory card with voice files in the display. Without it the display plays its chime.
display.updatesHint: Firmware and voice pack updates are not built into this version yet.
display.security: The link is not secured: the display does not require pairing. Use it only in a trusted environment.
settings.displayFeatureHint: Shows speed and warnings on a TN display over Bluetooth. The "Display" area appears only after you switch this on.
display.nightHint: The display dims during this time.
display.cacheHint: How long the display keeps showing its last picture when the app sends nothing.
display.connectedOnly: Available once the display is connected.
display.update.upToDate: The display is up to date.
display.update.autoHint: Once a day while the display is connected. Nothing is installed without your tap. The request goes to GitHub, where the phone's IP address is visible.
display.update.sourceUnavailable: The update source is not reachable or not public yet.
display.update.badRelease: The release is incomplete or damaged. Nothing was installed.
display.update.needsIntermediate: This update needs an intermediate update first. This app version cannot do that yet.
display.update.appTooOld: This update needs a newer app.
display.update.notPossible: The update is not possible for this display.
display.update.failed: The update failed. The display keeps running the old version.
display.update.failedCode: The display refused the update (code {code}). It keeps running the old version.
display.update.installing: Transferring to the display … keep the app open and stay nearby.
display.update.blocker.noOta: This display does not support updates.
display.update.confirmBody: Version {version} will be transferred to the display. It takes a few minutes, then the display restarts. Stay nearby and keep the app open.
display.update.unsigned: Warning: this release is not signed. The app only checks that the file arrives complete and unchanged as announced (size and SHA-256), not who made it. Install only updates you expect.
display.update.signed: Signature checked: the release comes from your key.
display.update.unsignedShort: Not signed. The app only checks size and SHA-256.
display.update.badSignature: The release's signature is invalid or from an unknown key. Nothing was installed.
display.pack.title: Sounds and voice files
display.pack.hint: Copies the tones and the voice files to the display's memory card. Without them the display plays its built-in tone.
display.pack.inApp: In the app: {n} files, {voice} of them voice files.
display.pack.noVoice: Voice files are missing in this app version; only the tones are transferred.
display.pack.done: Done. The files are on the card.
display.pack.failed: The transfer stopped ({file}). Try again; the file is overwritten.
display.pack.cancelled: Cancelled. A file that was started is incomplete on the card and is overwritten next time.
display.pack.blocker.noCard: The display has no memory card inserted.
display.pack.blocker.empty: This app version contains no files.
display.idleHint: The display shows the TNV logo while no trip is running. Start the drive mode and the driving screen appears.
display.connectFailing: The connection does not work. Is the display switched on, in range and not already connected to another phone? It connects to one device only.
offline.auto.hint: The app keeps the surroundings of your location available offline and adjusts them when you travel far.
offline.regions.hint: Only the chosen regions are kept offline on the device. Back to "Automatic" restores the area around your location.
offline.all.hint: All regions of the server are kept offline on the device.
offline.limitChoose: Choose the upper limit for offline data
offline.doesNotFit: The chosen data does not fit the upper limit; part of it is not loaded.
offline.regions.none: The server offers no regions to choose.
offline.regions.warn: If you choose regions yourself, other areas are removed from the device at the next sync.
offline.region.leaving: will be removed at the next sync
offline.needsConnection: The list of regions needs a connection to the server. It appears as soon as there is one.
offline.onlineOnly: Outside the offline area, speed limits are available online only. If you tap a road there, its exact coordinate is sent to the server for the lookup (the app stores nothing of it). The drive mode never looks anything up online.
data.title: Offline data
data.wifiOnlyHint: Large map data is downloaded over Wi-Fi only. Small live reports always arrive.
data.unknown: Size not known yet — connect to a server first.
data.regionNote: The library cannot select single regions yet; everything the server offers is loaded.
info.title: Sources and licences
info.osm: Map data and speed limits come from OpenStreetMap, © OpenStreetMap contributors, licence: Open Database License (ODbL).
info.maplibre: The map is drawn with MapLibre Native (BSD-2-Clause).
info.reports: Hazard reports come from users. The information is a hint, not official signage.
limit.interval.pickEnd: Tap the other end of the stretch of road the limit applies to.
limit.interval.previewLength: Stretch of road of about {length} m
limit.interval.previewFailed: The stretch could not be checked. You can still send the proposal.
limit.privacy.interval: Sent are the value and the two end points of the stretch (exact coordinates), nothing else.
limit.error.noRoadFound: No road was found near one of the two points. Tap closer to the road.
limit.error.noRoadBetweenPoints: The two points are not on the same road.
limit.error.intervalTooLong: The stretch is too long. Pick two points closer together.
limit.error.intervalTooShort: The stretch is too short. Pick two points further apart.
limit.error.noRoadData: The server has no road data for this area.
limit.error.notOffered: The server does not take speed-limit proposals at the moment.
